title: Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.00047v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. translated_title: 刻画一种推理时PRM剪枝片段嫁接失效的配置：来自三个推理大语言模型的证据
translated_abstract: 并行思维链中的多样性坍缩催生了基于一种自然设计的推理时干预方法：当过程奖励模型（PRM）剪除某条思维链时，将其高PRM前缀提取出来，并原样作为上下文示范嫁接到仍在解码的姊妹链中。我们将这一机制——PRM剪枝片段嫁接（PPFG）——分离出来，作为跨轨迹步骤级迁移最节省成本的操作化方式，并在先前片段嫁接工作仅在额外补偿性成分下才能报告增益的工作点上对其进行测试。在配备Math-Shepherd的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，对完整MATH500（n=500，三个随机种子）进行实验，停滞定向与随机定向两种PPFG变体在所有测量维度上均与独立并行CoT基线在统计上不可区分。我们刻画了其原因：对322个停滞规则注入事件的四桶分类显示，仅有14%的注入针对了真正陷入困境的链条
tldr: 该论文通过在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Math-Shepherd上的系统性实验证明，推理时的PRM剪枝片段嫁接（PPFG）在MATH500上与独立并行CoT基线统计上无差异，其失效根源在于仅14%的注入事件真正针对了陷入困境的思维链。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that inference-time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG) is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on MATH500 with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Math-Shepherd, and attributes this inertness to the fact that only 14% of injection events targeted genuinely struggling chains.
